claims.text: check validates outcome and cost against run.schema via _selection and returns passed checks with sorted memory receipts capped at 256.
_selection requires a post-open same-run episode else memory_required, and adds lesson and negative witnesses for error, HOLD, red or repair outcomes else memory_debt.
_valid verifies committed active unit ownership, lifecycle, scope, receipts, evidence digests and episode body equality, while _evidence pins descriptors and refuses symlinks.

decision.rule: Change here when closure witness selection, validity rules or receipt capacity needs to change.
decision.failure: Closes pass without same-run memory, invalid or inherited units are credited, or evidence digests mismatch.

questions.q: Where does check select the memory witnesses for run closure?
Where should I change the episode, lesson and negative witness requirements?
Where can I debug why closure raises memory_debt or hash_mismatch?
